name: Funding-fear capitulation composite (negative funding + extreme fear AND-gate)
rationale: The cleanest version of niche #5: a long arms ONLY when positioning AND sentiment both flag a flush at once — perp funding has gone NEGATIVE (shorts paying longs, leveraged crowd is positioned bearish and over-extended) WHILE crypto Fear&Greed sits in its extreme-fear band. The thesis is that a real capitulation needs the derivatives crowd AND the spot/sentiment crowd to capitulate together; either alone is noisy, but their AND-intersection is a rarer, higher-conviction reversal. Both inputs are BOUNDED and mean-reverting, so no drifting-level trap, and the AND makes this the lowest-turnover member of the capitulation family — 10bps fees barely bite. Funding bands are fit around realized Binance levels (negative side of the median, well inside the ±1e-4 clamp) so the filter genuinely excludes only bars where shorts pay. Exit when EITHER gauge normalizes (fear lifts to greed OR funding turns positive). DISCONFIRMER 1: the fear_greed-alone and funding-alone siblings are in this cohort — if neither-AND fails to beat the better single signal's deflated Sharpe, the composite adds nothing. DISCONFIRMER 2: requiring two simultaneous extremes is rare; too few trades to clear the Gate minimum is honest 'insufficient evidence', not an edge. DISCONFIRMER 3: the purged+embargoed holdout slice must stay positive or it is just buy-the-2022-bottom in disguise. The Gate disposes; an honest FAIL is valid.
catalyst: funding_rate negative AND fear_greed in extreme-fear band simultaneously
